description: Universe definition. Widening the universe is a config change, not a pipeline change: raise perSector, add sectors, relax the screen, or extend history and re-run `npm run build:data`.

liquidity.note: Applied to real history, not just the screener snapshot.

selection.note: Within each sector, the largest names that clear every liquidity gate are kept, up to perSector.

history.note: minBarsRequired is the hard floor to enter the universe at all. A name still needs 253 bars for a 12-1 score and 127 for a 6-1 score; short-history names are kept and flagged rather than silently ranked.

industries.note: An industry becomes its own ranked, drillable bucket once at least this many universe members belong to it.

macro.label: Oil
macro.note: Crude futures history is not available on this API plan, so a liquid oil ETF stands in for the oil series.

appBundle.note: How many trailing daily closes ship inside the app bundle. The full history stays in data/prices for any other artifact.
